Heap page adalah wadah item, bukan ident: A heap page contains items, not business identity
Heap table PostgreSQL disimpan sebagai k: A PostgreSQL heap table is stored as a collection of pages. Conceptually, a page has page metadata, an array of line pointers or ItemIdData, free space, and tuple items. A line pointer provides a slot pointing to an item's offset and length; it helps the backend find a tuple on the page without becoming an application column. Pages and slots are physical addresses that can change when a row is moved or rewritten. Page size, alignment, and access-method details are implementation details to read from the relevant version and build documentation, not to infer from one table's size.
Worked table di lesson ini sengaja hanya: This lesson's worked table deliberately stores only a miniature of heap structure as ordinary rows. `ordinal` gives the conceptual order, while `evidence_kind = authored_model` states that no raw page was read. The learner can identify the parts holding pointers and tuples without claiming that a particular disk page has the same slot count or offsets. This builds vocabulary before using lower-level inspection tools; an ordinary table is not a page image.
Tuple header mengatur cara atribut dibac: The tuple header controls how attributes are read
Sebuah heap tuple memiliki fixed header: A heap tuple has a fixed header containing transaction information and tuple shape, and can then have a NULL bitmap, a legacy object identifier in certain conditions, alignment padding, and user data. PostgreSQL documentation explains that `t_hoff` points to the start of user data and must follow the platform's MAXALIGN. A NULL bitmap exists only when a tuple has NULLs; its bits tell which attributes have no value so a reader must not take the next byte as if every column were present. Alignment also means a fixed-width type does not always start immediately after the previous byte.
Kesalahan pemula adalah menjumlahkan pan: A beginner's mistake is to add text and integer lengths and call the result the tuple size. The header, bitmap, padding, varlena representation, and possible TOAST all affect layout. `attlen` and `attalign` come from attribute metadata, not from column names. We do not invent a total byte count in this fixture. The target is reasoning: NULL changes the read path, alignment changes offsets, and the tuple header carries information needed for MVCC and decoding.
ctid mengikuti tuple version, bukan row: ctid follows the tuple version, not the business row
`ctid` adalah system column yang menunju: `ctid` is a system column pointing to the tuple-version location at that time. UPDATE can create a new version elsewhere; a HOT update can use the same page when its conditions hold, while a rewrite such as VACUUM FULL can move the row. Therefore ctid can change even when the primary key and business values remain the same. MVCC also makes an old version relevant to a snapshot that still needs it. Do not store ctid as a foreign key, permanent cursor, or business deduplication key.
Jika aplikasi perlu menemukan invoice, g: If an application needs to find an invoice, use an identity that is actually contracted, such as `invoice_id`, and reread the row as needed. `ctid` is useful for narrow, fast diagnostic operations, but its validity is tied to the tuple version and rewrite operations. This lesson does not read raw pages or prove version order; it asks the learner to state the evidence boundary before drawing conclusions from a physical address.

Shared buffers dan OS cache adalah lapis: Shared buffers and the OS cache are different layers
PostgreSQL memakai shared buffers untuk: PostgreSQL uses shared buffers to hold some table and index pages used by the instance. Beneath them, the operating system can also have a file page cache. When a backend needs a block, it can find it in shared buffers; otherwise PostgreSQL reads from the lower layer and fills a buffer. That lower layer can serve from the OS cache or storage, so `shared read` is not identical to a physical disk read. Conversely, `shared hit` means the needed page found an available buffer at that time, not that CPU, locks, decompression, or output transfer became free.
Ukuran `shared_buffers` adalah konfigura: The size of `shared_buffers` is server configuration, not the total RAM available to every process. The OS cache remains part of the story, while other memory is used by backends, extensions, the kernel, and other workloads. Do not treat one query's hit rate as a global cache-health percentage without a denominator and context. This lesson separates the layers so the learner does not turn one counter into an unsupported storage claim.
BUFFERS memberi accounting, bukan sensor: BUFFERS provides accounting, not a complete disk sensor

Repeated runs can change because of cache, autovacuum, checkpoints, OS scheduling, background workload, and timing. One output does not produce p50 or p95. When using EXPLAIN ANALYZE, note that measurement has overhead and does not send a result set as an ordinary client execution would; even a SELECT can change CPU, locks, and cache.

Karakter, byte, datum, dan relation menj: Characters, bytes, datums, and relations answer different questions
`char_length(text)` menghitung karakter: `char_length(text)` counts characters according to text semantics, while `octet_length(text)` counts encoded bytes. In UTF-8, `é` is one character but two bytes, and `猫` is one character but three bytes. These numbers are deterministic transformations of the chosen value; they are not tuple or disk size. `pg_column_size(value)` reports the bytes used to store one datum, and when applied to a column can reflect compression that has already occurred. It is still not the size of the entire row, page, index, TOAST table, or relation.
Worked fixture mengeluarkan hanya char l: The worked fixture outputs only character length and UTF-8 byte length so expected rows can be read without inventing storage results. The learner still needs to recognize `pg_column_size` and its limits: datum size, logical text size, tuple size, and relation size have different scopes. If the question concerns API transfer, octet length may be relevant; if it concerns storage, consider the header, alignment, compression, TOAST, indexes, and cache.
TOAST menangani nilai besar dengan kebij: TOAST handles large values with policies that must not be guessed
PostgreSQL tidak membiarkan heap tuple m: PostgreSQL does not allow a heap tuple to span pages arbitrarily. For varlena types that support it, TOAST can try compression and/or move a value out of line into an associated TOAST table. Storage modes such as `PLAIN`, `MAIN`, `EXTERNAL`, and `EXTENDED` change the policy; the compression method can also be influenced by a column option and the server default. Therefore a large value does not automatically imply one compression ratio, one chunk count, or out-of-line storage.
`pg_column_size` dapat membantu membaca: `pg_column_size` can help read datum size under the conditions being inspected, but it does not replace `pg_total_relation_size` for a relation and does not describe every index or table overhead. `pg_column_compression` and related TOAST functions also have meaning only for the value and environment actually inspected. This lesson does not use pageinspect, an extension, or raw files. It teaches policy-aware reasoning: type, storage option, compression, data shape, version, and write operations can change the evidence.
Projection sempit mengurangi kontrak dat: A narrow projection reduces the data contract carried
`SELECT *` membawa semua kolom yang diiz: `SELECT *` carries every column allowed by the query, including wide columns the caller may not need. A narrow projection such as `SELECT value_id, label` makes the result contract clearer and can reduce data that must be processed, moved, or detoasted; it must not be sold as a latency guarantee without measurement. Indexes, visibility, filters, the client protocol, the planner, and other column needs still affect cost.
Praktik yang aman adalah mulai dari kolo: A safe practice is to start with the columns actually needed, then measure with a known query and environment when optimization is required. Do not delete a payload merely because `octet_length` is large, and do not assume a long payload consumes heap space equal to its logical bytes. If storage policy or compression changes, the expected physical result can change too. Contract correctness and data needs come before guessed disk numbers.

Projection sempit menjaga kontrak data d: A narrow projection preserves the data contract and avoids carrying unneeded columns. Performance impact still needs measurement.

Value `repeated` memiliki 16 karakter da: The `repeated` value has 16 characters and 16 bytes in the fixture. What is a safe storage conclusion?
Logical dan UTF-8 byte length sama pada: Logical and UTF-8 byte lengths match for that value; the compression or physical TOAST result is still unknown.
PostgreSQL pasti mengompres value menjad: PostgreSQL definitely compresses the value to eight bytes on every installation.
Karena tidak ada perbedaan, value pasti: Because there is no difference, the value must be inline and have no varlena header.
Kesamaan dua transformasi hanya berlaku: The equality of the two transformations applies only to the fixture's value and encoding. Storage policy can produce different evidence.

Datum size dapat mencerminkan compressio: Datum size can reflect compression, but a relation also includes tuple/page overhead, indexes, TOAST, and other objects.
pg_column_size selalu salah bila hasilny: pg_column_size is always wrong when its result is smaller than octet_length.
Relation size pasti sama dengan logical: Relation size must equal logical text bytes minus that compression ratio.
Metrik value dan metrik relation memilik: Value and relation metrics have different scopes. Compression on one datum does not give the total object size.
Benar: tambah scope storage yang relevan: Correct: add the relevant storage scope before concluding relation size.
Belum tepat: compression dapat membuat s: Not quite: compression can make a stored datum smaller than logical bytes.
Belum tepat: relation memiliki banyak ov: Not quite: a relation has much overhead and a ratio cannot simply be extrapolated.

TOAST, compression, projection, cache, p: TOAST, compression, projection, cache, plan, row layout, and data distribution can change the work path.

Wide value adalah input bagi beberapa ke: A wide value is an input to multiple policies and storage paths. Page count or I/O needs appropriate evidence.
Benar: storage dan execution context men: Correct: storage and execution context determine evidence, not logical value length alone.

Mulai dari scope metrik: karakter, encod: Start with metric scope: characters, encoded bytes, datums, tuples/pages, and relations are not synonyms.
TOAST adalah kebijakan varlena yang dapa: TOAST is a varlena policy that can compress or move values out of line; do not set a ratio or chunk count without evidence.
Projection sempit memperjelas kontrak da: A narrow projection clarifies the contract and may reduce work, but a performance claim still requires comparable measurement.

Bandingkan char_length, octet_length, pg: Compare char_length, octet_length, pg_column_size, tuple/page size, and relation size. Explain TOAST's role and why SELECT * and a narrow projection have trade-offs, without producing a fixed compression ratio or disk size from this fixture.
`EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS)` dapat menam: `EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS)` can show shared blocks hit, read, dirtied, and written. Local counters represent buffers for TEMP tables and indexes; temp read/written counters represent temporary work-file blocks, such as sort or hash spills, rather than TEMP-table buffers. The fixture temp_read/temp_written fields model those work-file counters. The counters help identify plan parts touching buffers or work files. However, ANALYZE executes the statement, so mutations or functions with side effects are real operations. Plain EXPLAIN does not provide an actual buffer trace; an example not taken from execution must be labeled authored.
